mintAuthority.summary: EURCV Ethereum mint is restricted to SG-FORGE's immutable registrar EOA. The token is a UUPS SmartCoin V4 proxy: the immutable technical EOA executes upgrades only after the registrar has authorized the candidate implementation; there is no separate proxy-admin slot.

controls.label: EURCV SmartCoin registrar and direct minter
controls.evidence: At pinned Ethereum block 26095802, getOperators() returned this registrar address and eth_getCode returned 0x. The implementation remained 0xf4ccc80c4b831a0d8d1414f2aca82a3d760ff05b. Its freshly fetched verified SmartCoin V4 source gates mint() with onlyAllowedMinter and uses the registrar as immutable mint authority, without a numeric token cap. Registrar authorization is also required before a technical-operator upgrade.

controls.label: EURCV SmartCoin technical upgrade executor
controls.evidence: At pinned Ethereum block 26095802, getOperators() returned this technical address and eth_getCode returned 0x. The verified implementation gates _authorizeUpgrade() with onlyTechnical and requires consumeAuthorizeImplementation() for registrar authorization. The implementation was unchanged at 0xf4ccc80c4b831a0d8d1414f2aca82a3d760ff05b; the correct EIP-1967 admin slot 0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103 returned zero, and newImplementation() returned zero.

sources.label: White & Case - SG-FORGE ACPR e-money institution licence for EURCV

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530438, getOperators() returned unchanged registrar, operations, and technical EOAs; version() returned V4, newImplementation() returned zero, and the EIP-1967 implementation slot returned 0xf4ccc80c4b831a0d8d1414f2aca82a3d760ff05b. Verified source establishes registrar-only minting and the registrar-authorization plus technical-execution UUPS upgrade sequence. XRPL, Stellar, and Solana remain separate issuer-operated deployments outside this Ethereum control review. SG-FORGE is an ACPR-authorised Electronic Money Institution and EURCV is structured as a MiCA electronic-money token, so the issuer is prudentially supervised. However SG-FORGE publishes only a self-reported daily 100%-collateral figure on its own website; no named independent accounting/verification firm attests EURCV reserves (the Hacken work is smart-contract-only and RWA.xyz lists no auditor), so supply is not independently reconciled and reconciliation is unknown. Under the rubric an unreconciled mint stays critical regardless of prudential supervision. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the registrar EOA can mint without a numeric cap, daily self-verification is not an independent whole-supply attestation, and ACPR supervises the authorized EMI issuer.
